provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: A closed cohort experiences genotype-specific viability only between these stages. No mutation,migration or genotype-call error; genotype labels do not change. Adults are a selected subset of the original cohort. Adult frequency_j=zygote_frequency_j*w_j/sum_k zygote_frequency_k*w_k. The separate overall survival calibration fixes that denominator and therefore absolute viability probabilities,not only relative fitness.
equilibrium_question: For the separate idealized subsequent random-mating viability-selection model with the same w values, find the interior allele-A equilibrium when the heterozygote has higher viability than both homozygotes. Do not treat survivor genotype frequencies as zygote Hardy-Weinberg frequencies.
scope: Controlled population-genetic accounting and selection-model interpretation,not a genetic intervention or an estimate from a named biological population.
